Hello, my Bitforturn BS-1 (5.1 TH/s) was delivered on September 17, 2026.
It suddenly stopped working. The fan only moves slightly and stops, and I
noticed a burnt smell and black marks near the yellow power connector on
the miner.

I have disconnected it from power and have not tried to turn it on again.

Could you please advise me on how to proceed with a warranty claim or
repair? I can provide photos and my order number (Shop····).

Hi,

Thank you for the detail, and for unplugging it straight away. That was the right call. Please leave it disconnected and don't power it up again, even briefly.

Scorching and a burnt smell at the power connector is a hardware failure, and it's covered. I've put your BS-1 in front of JD and Georges for the warranty approval now, with your order number and the fault as you described it. A colleague is picking it up today and will confirm here.

Two things that will speed it up: reply to this message with the photos of the connector and the burn marks, plus a clear photo of the serial number on the unit. One short video of the fan twitching and stopping helps too, if you can take it safely without plugging it in for long.

One question I have to ask on every warranty case: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? Overclocked units aren't covered, so a plain no on the record keeps this moving.

Once it's approved I'll come back with the return arrangements and the replacement, and I'll handle both ends myself.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

I'm following up on my Bitforturn BS-1 issue. You mentioned that the team
would contact me shortly, but I haven't received an update yet.

The miner is still not working, and I noticed a burnt smell and black marks
around the yellow power connector. I've already provided photos of the
damage.

Could you please check whether the technical team has reviewed my case and
let me know what the next steps are regarding warranty, repair, or
replacement?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards

Hello,

Thanks for following up, and sorry for the wait on this one.

Your case has been looked at. Our technical side reviewed the photos and the symptoms you described, and the BS-1 has been confirmed as a hardware fault, so it falls under warranty. That part is settled, and you do not need to send anything else in.

What is left is the approval on the return itself, which JD and Georges handle. That is with them right now and they will confirm it shortly. As soon as it is approved I will come straight back to you in this thread with the return instructions, the prepaid label and the reference to write on the box, and I will arrange the replacement at the same time so nothing waits on you.

Please keep the miner unplugged until then, and keep the box if you still have it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

I'm following up on my Bitforturn BS-1 warranty claim. I haven't received
an update from the technical team yet.

I also want to emphasize that there was a burnt smell when the miner
stopped working, along with visible black marks around the yellow power
connector. I've attached photos showing the connector damage.

Could you please confirm that the technical team has received my case and
let me know the next steps regarding warranty, repair, or replacement?

Thank you for your help.

Hello,

Yes, I can confirm it. Your case and your photos are with us, nothing is missing, and you do not need to send anything again.

Hal on our technical side has already reviewed the burnt smell and the scorching around the yellow power connector. His verdict is that the BS-1 has failed on the power side, which is a hardware fault and covered under warranty. That conclusion is recorded on your order.

The only step left is the sign off from JD or Georges, which is what turns the warranty claim into an actual return and replacement. That is in front of them today. The moment it is signed off I will reply in this same thread with the prepaid return label, the reference to write on the outside of the box, and the replacement unit, which I arrange at the same time so it is ready to go out as soon as yours reaches our warehouse.

I am sorry you have had to chase this since the nineteenth. It should not have taken three emails, and I am not going to let it sit any longer than today.

Please keep the miner unplugged in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

The moment it is signed, you get the prepaid label and the return reference from me in this thread, and your replacement BS-1 is reserved at the same time so it ships as soon as your unit reaches our warehouse.

What is missing is one authorisation from JD or Georges, and until that is on the order the system will not let me buy your return label or reserve the replacement unit. The team is offline until tomorrow at ten in the morning Eastern time. Your case is sitting at the top of what they open, marked with the burn damage and with how long you have been waiting. You do not need to write again to keep it there, and you will get my reply in this thread the moment it is approved, with the prepaid label, the reference for the box and the replacement arrangements all in one message.

It does not make up for the wait, but I have made you a code for a future order, HD-••••••, twenty five dollars off, yours alone, on orders over a hundred. It is entirely separate from the warranty claim and takes nothing away from it.
